full_prompt_en: An oil-painted tavern interior fills with a large crowd gathered around a heavy wooden table. In the foreground, a woman in a dusty rose dress sits at the left corner, a man in blue leans across the right edge, and several men in dark broad-brimmed hats gesture with cups between them. Earthenware bowls, bread, and clear amber drinks cover the tabletop. More faces pack the dim room behind them, receding into brown shadow beneath hanging kitchenware and shelves. The painting uses small, lively brush marks to articulate faces, sleeves, and table objects, while the far crowd and dark walls merge into broader glazed strokes. Warm ochre, umber, muted red, slate blue, and creamy white distribute attention through the dense scene. Light enters from the left front and catches cheeks, white collars, ceramic rims, and glass vessels; the rear room remains smoky and low in contrast. Many figures overlap, yet gestures and bright patches lead the eye from the nearest table into the crowded middle distance. The low viewpoint keeps the table as a broad horizontal anchor. The whole painting has a busy, conversational rhythm, with compact human groups and tiny object highlights set inside a deep, dark communal space.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅油画里的酒馆室内挤满围着厚重木桌的人群。前景左角坐着穿灰粉裙子的女子，右边身穿蓝衣的男子探过桌缘，几个戴深色宽檐帽的男子在中间举杯交谈。陶碗、面包和盛着琥珀色饮料的透明杯散布桌面。更多面孔挤在后方昏暗房间里，逐渐退入棕色阴影，头顶有悬挂厨具与架子。绘画用细小活泼的笔触刻画面容、袖子和桌上器物，远处人群与暗墙则汇入较宽的罩染笔道。暖赭、棕褐、低饱和红、石板蓝与奶白色在密集场景中分配注意力。光从左前方进入，抓住脸颊、白领口、陶器边缘和玻璃杯；后屋烟雾般昏暗，反差较低。许多人物互相遮挡，手势与亮色斑块仍把目光从近桌引向拥挤的中景。低视点使桌子成为宽阔水平锚点。整幅画在人群小团块和器物碎亮点之间形成繁忙交谈的节奏，处于深暗的公共室内空间。
style_prompt_en: An oil-painted surface combines small animated brush marks in the focal area with broader, thinly glazed shadow passages behind. Earthy umber and ochre dominate, interrupted by muted red, slate blue, and little creamy white accents. Light from one side touches raised edges and clustered highlights while much of the rear plane remains warm, smoky darkness. Many overlapping rounded forms crowd the middle register; a heavy horizontal foreground band stabilizes their movement. Near contours are described by short tonal strokes rather than rigid outlines, and distant contours dissolve into the brown ground. Space deepens through successive overlapping groups, shrinking detail, and decreasing contrast. The eye hops among small lit points and gestures before settling into the dark recesses. Dense detail and uneven light create an energetic social rhythm across the whole frame.
style_prompt_zh: 油画表面在焦点区域结合细小活跃笔痕，在后方阴影处使用较宽而薄的罩染色层。土褐与赭色占主导，低饱和红、石板蓝和少量奶白亮点穿插其间。偏一侧的光点亮凸起边缘和成团高光，后部大多留在暖调、烟雾般的深暗里。许多相互重叠的圆润形体挤在画面中带，一条厚重水平前景带稳住其动势。近处轮廓靠短促明暗笔触描述，而非僵硬描边；远处轮廓溶入棕色底层。连续交叠的团块、缩小的细节与递减反差建立空间。视线在小亮点与斜向动作之间跳跃，最后进入暗处。密度较高的细节与不均匀光照使整幅画呈现活跃的群体节奏。
theme_en: A crowded village tavern gathered around food and drink
theme_zh: 围着食物和酒杯聚集的乡村酒馆众人
name: Jan Steen
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
